issues: Scrambled/merged numbering structure: item 14 is run together with item 13 instead of being a separate numbered entry.

Meaning drift in item g: should be 'to determine their own decision' (singular) rather than 'decisions'

Scrambled/merged list structure in paragraph (4): lettered items b and c run together on one line; list markers should be separated and consistently ordered.

Meaning drift/awkward rendering: "So that everyone may know of it, orders..." lacks the implied subject (Regent/authority) and should be rendered as a standard legal formula ("In order that everyone may know thereof, the promulgation ... is ordered").
